fato_historico: 1962: Uganda becomes an independent Commonwealth realm.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with a spirit of autonomy today, much like a nation finding its own path to sovereignty. For you, Libra, this energy invites a beautiful recalibration of your personal boundaries. It is a good time to consider what truly makes your soul feel independent and free while maintaining your signature grace and delicate social harmony.
frase_do_dia: True freedom is the power to define your own path with grace.

conselho: Assert your needs today with the same quiet strength found in independence.
